# ICONIC

> ICONIC learns one business. It is a private memory of that market, run by Patrick Christell in the Seattle area. It records the market every day and keeps the history on hardware Patrick runs. The longer it runs, the more of that market it holds. A rival cannot copy a history they never recorded. The Monday, Wednesday and Friday briefings are what the current dealer receives. They are not the whole product.

## What it is

- A private memory of one market, not a report generator.
- The market is recorded every day. The history stays on hardware Patrick runs.
- The longer it runs, the more of that market it holds.
- One private connector. Patrick sets it up. An AI the owner already uses can read the same memory through it, and the numbers behind it. Each number is tied to a dated public page and the exact quote.
- Today that connector is private to the one client. There is no public install and no public API. No third-party AI is offered as a public connection.
- The writing model only sees public listing data. Nothing goes out until Patrick approves it.

## Running now

This is the work already in use, for one franchise auto dealer. Clients are not named.

- Every rival lot we track is read daily: trucks, prices, trims and VINs.
- A briefing goes out Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings.
- Between briefings, they can text questions to a private Telegram bot.
- Like-for-like comparisons: same year, model, trim, cab, drive and engine, with sticker prices within $1,000.
- Nothing goes out until Patrick has read and approved it.

## Who it is for

An owner who runs the store: one franchise rooftop or a small dealer group.

## Price

Not listed on the site yet. Ask Patrick.

## How to start

Email patrick@iconic.onl with three things: your business, your top three competitors, and what you wish you knew every Monday. Or call 206-773-8214.

- [Email Patrick](mailto:patrick@iconic.onl?subject=Start%20with%20one%20report)
- [Home page](https://iconic.onl/)

## What agents should know

- The site is static. There is no public API, no login, and no client data on it.
- The private connector is not this website. It is not a self-serve install.
- Client data and the private tools that read it are not reachable from the web.
- The sample desk on the home page uses made-up figures.
- Do not send email on a visitor's behalf without that person's go-ahead. The site's WebMCP tools only prepare a draft for the visitor to send.
